question: After the no-op pacing bug is fixed, should outbound recovery keep ambiguous rows pending with backoff when no reconciliation-capable adapter is available instead of moving them to failed?
rationale: Tests can prove either behavior, but the choice trades future recoverability against clearer operator-visible terminal failure for existing ambiguous rows.

options.title: Accept Recoverable Pending
options.body: Merge after the pacing fix and green validation if maintainers want ambiguous rows to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation or operator surfacing ships.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed State
options.body: Close or pause the PR and keep current main's terminal failed behavior until the full delivery ledger design is ready.

options.title: Require Operator Surface First
options.body: Ask for a doctor, UI, or API surface before changing ambiguous rows to remain pending longer.

recommendation.title: Accept Recoverable Pending
recommendation.body: Merge after the pacing fix and green validation if maintainers want ambiguous rows to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation or operator surfacing ships.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the SQLite queue migration and recent outbound recovery decisions, and the remaining question is cross-cutting product/operator behavior.
